create.name: Stichting Leven in Aandacht
create.bio:
Stichting Leven in Aandacht is the Dutch foundation, set up in 1995, that spreads the mindfulness practice of the Vietnamese Zen teacher Thich Nhat Hanh across the Netherlands and Flanders. Registered in Leiden and part of the international Plum Village community, it supports a network of around seventy-five local meditation groups, or sanghas, together with more than ten groups for young adults in the Wake Up movement, and it raises money for schools and care projects for children in Vietnam. It also publishes the magazine De Klankschaal three times a year for its donors and keeps a webshop of books by Thich Nhat Hanh and other Plum Village authors.

Its deepening programme brings days of mindfulness, courses and silent weekend retreats to venues such as the Theosophical Centre in Naarden and the Bosoord retreat house in Loenen, guided by lay and monastic Dharma teachers and members of the Order of Interbeing; it also invites monks and nuns from Plum Village and the European Institute of Applied Buddhism in Germany on teaching tours. The foundation's YouTube channel, running since 2018, carries Dutch and English Dharma talks, guided meditations and retreat recordings, and its website offers free practice texts and sung chants in Dutch.

courses.title: Stilte, thuiskomen bij jezelf [80611]
courses.description: A day of mindfulness in Naarden, the last in a series on silence, with sitting, walking and eating meditation, conscious breathing, writing and voice exercises. Guided by Dharma teacher Jacquelien van Galen and Order of Interbeing member Marijke Steenbergen.

courses.title: Diep luisteren - Stilte retraite [80643]
courses.description: A four-day silent retreat at Bosoord in Loenen led by Dharma teacher Hilly Bol, giving time to rest, slow down and listen deeply to body and heart.

courses.title: Zaadjes van vreugde water geven - Dag in Aandacht
courses.description: A day of mindfulness in Den Dolder on 'watering the seeds of joy', starting from insight into one's own emotions and motives, guided by members of the Order of Interbeing and experienced practitioners.
courses.price: dana (donatie); minimaal € 25 (of, als je een minimuminkomen hebt, € 15)

free_resources.title: Basisoefeningen
free_resources.description: Short Dutch introductions to everyday practices in the Plum Village tradition, such as mindful breathing, eating, walking and the use of gathas, with notes on how to do each one.

free_resources.title: Gezongen recitaties
free_resources.description: Recordings and sheet music of Plum Village chants and hymns sung in Dutch, including the Heart Sutra, the Three Refuges and the morning and evening hymns.
